prayerExcerpt.en-US: Jesus was only nine months in the womb of Mary, three hours on the cross, three days in the sepulchre, but He is always in the tabernacle.
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: Jesus esteve apenas nove meses no ventre de Maria, três horas na cruz, três dias no sepulcro, mas está sempre no tabernáculo.

meta.face: A Brabant countryman of about fifty, CLEAN-SHAVEN, with a ruddy, weather-reddened complexion and a BROAD, SQUARE face with STRONG JAW CORNERS, after the Book of Hours miniature — a LOW, broad forehead, a SHORT, BROAD nose with a ROUNDED tip, SMALL, DEEP-SET blue-grey eyes under HEAVY, STRAIGHT brown brows, wide, weathered cheeks with deep smile-lines, a WIDE, straight mouth, PROMINENT ears; thick brown hair with the first grey, cut in a straight fringe across the brow and short over the ears; the gaze humble and kindly. Not the wedge-faced Cloud of this batch, nor the fair, flat-topped hyacinth.
meta.basis: A fifteenth-century Book of Hours miniature (Wikipedia's lead) shows him as a peasant in a red tunic with a staff, a broad face with a short, broad nose; Wikipedia gives his iconography as a pilgrim with hat and staff and an ox at his feet, and his patronage of sacristans. The card follows both.
